title: How should Concord handle coverage for Bash-only projects?
body: When `concord init` is run in a project whose code and tests are Bash, the generated `spec-coverage` command needs coverage settings. Concord's current coverage runner runs Jest and measures JavaScript, so a Jest-based declaration would fail on this project; leaving coverage undeclared makes `spec-coverage` exit with an error. What should Concord provide for Bash-only projects?

options.text: Concord measures which Bash source lines the Bash test scripts execute, and `spec-coverage` works for this project.
Concord reports Bash execution coverage as unsupported; setup clearly says coverage is incomplete until Concord supports it.
